tool: research/video-tools/vindex.py (vscan features -> segments -> OCR -> levels); frames via vgrab, text via vocr

conventions.coordinates: full-res pixels of the 592x1280 frame, top-left origin; pt = px * 393/592 (verified: V2 L21 pitch 28.03 pt vs the phone L35 pitch 28.09 pt for the same board)
conventions.times: seconds of video presentation time (vgrab V t grabs that exact frame)
conventions.t_first: first frame of the level with board ink (board building, or revealed from under an unlock popup)
conventions.t_built: ink reaches 97 % of its pre-tap peak
conventions.t_board: cleanest start frame: the LAST frame >= 0.1 s before the first board tap whose ink is >= 98.5 % of the pre-tap peak (tutorial hand not drawn yet); grabbed full-res as research/video-frames/V?/L0NN-start.png
conventions.t_first_tap: first touch disc on the board (the iOS screen-recording touch indicator; touch-DOWN; the game acts on release)
conventions.t_clear: last frame with arrow ink (the last arrow starts leaving)
conventions.t_win: the MAZE OUT! (V1) / Well Done! (V2) logo pops
conventions.taps: touch-disc tracks: t, x, y (px), outcome = exit (ink fell within 0.7 s) | bump (a confirmed heart loss within 1 s, given to the last board tap before it) | none | booster_bar (y > 1130); weak = seen in one frame or among shatter debris; near_hand = next to the tutorial pointer. Outcomes here are APPROXIMATE; vextract.py replay decides them per arrow.
conventions.heart_drops: hearts count falls and stays down >= 1 s (an iOS notification banner hides all 3 hearts for ~1 s: ignored)
conventions.screens: non-play stretches split by 2-fps frame signature; one full-res OCR per sub-segment; kind from the text
